structured.approach: Attempt 2 fixes both G1 refusals, and I rewrote feat.classification in full. (1) In the ZD-48470 overlap row I removed the inferred claim that both changes use the same transform.to_model reject path. The row now states only what the files say: both change the ap_pipeline vendor feed and both add a row rejection ('InvalidCurrency' in feed v2, 'paid_date' in feed v3). (2) I removed the sentence "Only CR-6 is customer-visible on its own" and the per-CR "customer-visible" column. The qualifier now rests only on sourced facts: the business need for AP managers, CR-6's new portal table, and how RETRO-2026-19 uses "Technical only". Whether other CRs, for example the CR-4 explanation prompt, are visible to users is now open question OQ-E. While re-checking the file I also tightened the FIN-OPS row ("the ticket does not mention max_tokens"). Everything else is unchanged from the inputs and requirement files read in attempt 1: same category, routing, impacted repositories and duplicate decisions. Shell use is blocked for this step (G9), so I read files with Read.

claims.text: FEAT-ZD-48600 is classified as New Feature. The source file records expected_type New Feature, and the ticket asks for new functions, a new optional feed column and a new optional argument.

The entry is not qualified as Technical Only, because CR-6 adds a new portal table (renderOverdueRisk) for the AP managers' need. RETRO-2026-19 uses 'Technical only' for an item with no customer-visible change.

Technical sub-categories: CR-1 and CR-2 data engineering (ap_pipeline), CR-3 and CR-4 AI / data science (ap_forecast), CR-5 backend (ap_aging), CR-6 frontend (ap_portal), CR-7 integration and end-to-end tests across all four.

Impacted repositories: ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging, ap_portal. The feature routing map routes each to a coding agent and the end-to-end tests to the Testing Agent. The organisation-level routing map lists only ap_aging.
No duplicate was found, so nothing was merged. ZD-48211 and ZD-48501 share the overdue rule (unpaid, more than 30 days past due) with CR-5, but each asks for a different function or view.

ZD-48470 adds a currency column to the vendor feed (v2) and rejects invalid rows with reason 'InvalidCurrency'. This entry adds paid_date (feed v3) with reject reason 'paid_date', and its v3 column list does not include currency.
PROV-ACME-2026-11 replaces acme-text-2 with acme-text-3 and adds a system field to the explanation requests. CR-4 changes the prompt built by build_explanation_request.
ZD-48377 reports an invoice exactly 30 days past due landing in the 31-60 bucket instead of 1-30. CR-5 uses the same more-than-30-days boundary, and L-007 requires testing it explicitly.
The architecture requires keeping every existing signature and adding new functions.

open_questions: OQ-A: Should ap_aging have one shared overdue rule (unpaid, more than 30 days past due) for ZD-48211, ZD-48501 and CR-5, and in which order should they be built?
OQ-B: Should ZD-48470 (feed v2, currency) land first, and should feed v3 include currency? Its column list in the ZD-48600 source file does not.
OQ-C: PROV-ACME-2026-11 changes the model and adds a system field to the same explanation request that CR-4 changes. Which lands first?
OQ-D: Should the ZD-48377 boundary fix land before CR-5?
OQ-E: Are any change requests besides CR-6 visible to users (for example, does the CR-4 explanation prompt reach users)? The inputs do not say.
OQ-F: The Pre Backlog sheet and the DevOps board were not available; the duplicate check covered only the repository's requirement files (as OQ-1 in feat.prebacklog).
structured.summary: I rewrote feat.classification for FEAT-ZD-48600 to fix both G1 refusals. The unsupported transform.to_model claim and the per-CR "customer-visible" judgement are removed; visibility beyond CR-6 is now open question OQ-E. The classification itself is unchanged: New Feature, not Technical Only, a technical sub-category and routing owner for each CR, and impacted repositories ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging and ap_portal. No duplicates were merged. Related items ZD-48211, ZD-48501, ZD-48470, PROV-ACME-2026-11 and ZD-48377 are kept separate, with sequencing raised as non-blocking questions.
